    Data Management

    Export your local financial data for backup, or import past data with a guided, reviewed walkthrough.

    ✈ Flight Recorder Import

    Upload a bank statement (CSV) and let Paycheck Pilot find your paychecks, bills, and spending patterns — analyzed locally, nothing sent anywhere.

    Repair My Data

    If you imported data before a fix to how future paychecks were detected, this reviews what's already in your account and corrects it — no re-upload, no wipe. Your balances, other transactions, and household stay untouched.

    Financial Reset

    A guided fresh start: clears your bills, transactions, and paycheck schedule, then walks you through re-importing with the corrected logic. Your accounts, household, login, and sync stay exactly as they are.

    Public Document

    Delete My Account

    This permanently deletes:

    • Your login and account credentials
    • Your financial data — accounts, bills, income, transactions, goals
    • Your push notification subscriptions
    • Your synced data on our servers
    You're part of a shared household. Only your own membership and personal data are deleted — the household's shared data stays intact for other members.

    This cannot be undone.

    Household Management

    Shared Data

    Everyone keeps their own accounts, transactions, and income by default. These categories can be marked HOUSEHOLD when it makes sense — like a shared mortgage.

    Optional Sharing

    Your primary paycheck schedule is always part of your household's shared data — this setting does not make it private.

    You'll inherit the sharing setup the household owner already configured.
